segmentation.text: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer
shall stop in obedience to a stop sign or yield in compliance with a yield sign,
in compliance with the manner prescribed in subsection 1 [NRS-484B-257-1],
if a stop sign or a yield sign is erected at one or more entrances thereto
although not a part of a through highway
to vehicles not so obligated to stop or yield
and which are within the intersection
or approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard
during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

elements.justification: 'Traffic' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, of which the subject is a member; 'being controlled by a police officer' is dev.human_direction of role police_officer governing (dev.governs) the subject's approach carrier c or X (st.travel_region), read at the subject's entry.
A dev.traffic_signal governing c or X (dev.governs) that is not dev.inoperative ('installed and uncovered but showing no valid indication'), read at the subject's entry.
Same mapping as 'The driver of a vehicle' in the index: the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'driver' is the vehicle's controlled motion.

'Such driver' is the one so obliged: a dev.stop_sign or dev.yield_sign governs (dev.governs) the carrier c (st.lane_enters c X) the subject occupied (rel.occupies) when it entered X, or X itself — one of the 'one or more entrances' the words name.
Same mapping as 'yielding' in the index: the subject does not proceed (kin.speed above the halt tolerance) while the protected vehicle is in conflict, and does not collide with it (rel.contact).

'Vehicles' is the admitted aggregate. 'Not so obligated to stop or yield' is v whose approach carrier c2 of X (rel.occupies, st.lane_enters) is governed (dev.governs) by no stop sign and no yield sign, nor is X.
'Which are within the intersection': v's footprint overlaps X (rel.occupies), continuously since it occupied c2.
'During the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection': the subject's footprint overlaps X (rel.occupies) and its kin.speed is above the halt tolerance.

operationalizations.standard: proceed cautiously: proceed without creating a danger of a crash with the vehicles the words name
operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: the subject proceeds (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) while, under constant velocities, its centre and the other vehicle's approach within the time-to-collision threshold p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance — a present danger of a crash

operationalizations.standard: approaching so closely as to constitute an immediate hazard
operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: v approaching on its carrier is an immediate hazard where, under constant velocities, its centre and the subject's approach within the time-to-collision threshold p.conflict_horizon to a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance

residues.why: 'although' is concessive: the duty reaches signed entrances whether or not the intersection is part of a through highway, and the yielding owed by a driver entering through a signed entrance is the same in both cases; the words withhold the duty nowhere.

applicability: At every observation at which the subject's footprint overlaps an intersection X and has overlapped it continuously since its latest entry into X (having occupied at the observation before a carrier c with st.lane_enters(c, X)) and the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance); where at that entry observation a stop sign or a yield sign governed c or X (dev.governs), no police officer's direction (dev.human_direction of role police_officer) governed c or X, and no traffic signal that was not inoperative governed c or X.
obligation: Re-binding X and c as in the applicability: for every other road user v of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle not so obligated — v occupies a carrier c2 entering X, or overlaps X continuously since an observation at which it occupied such a c2, where no stop sign and no yield sign governs c2 or X (dev.governs) — and that either overlaps X or, on c2, has its closest approach to the subject within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance: the subject is not in contact with v (rel.contact), and it is not the case that the subject is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) while prim.closest_approach_within(subject, v; p.conflict_horizon) holds with prim.closest_approach_distance(subject, v; p.conflict_horizon) below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'cautiously' is read only through the yielding the words join to it: proceeding without a present danger of a crash with the vehicles named; no further speed bound is read.
'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion, whoever or whatever controls it.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A dev.yield_sign governs c; the subject entered X and moves across it with kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance; v occupies X having entered from c2, which no stop or yield sign governs; their closest approach lies within p.conflict_horizon at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene; the subject waits at rest until v has cleared, then moves across X with no closest approach to v within the bound.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No stop or yield sign governs c or X when the subject enters X.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Subject moving across X in conflict with v; dev.governs is absent, so whether a sign governs c, and whether v is so obligated, are unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject moves across X with no other road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: At an all-way stop, v entered X from c2, which a stop sign governs; the subject moves in conflict with v: v is itself obligated to stop, and this duty does not protect it.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition standard's kinematic channels

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width
